briefings.headline: Make Phillips work; attack the fastball
briefings.message: Tyler Phillips is the high-confidence expected starter. Hunt fastballs, especially early, and stay disciplined against his splitter and other offspeed pitches. Make him work—his average is 72 pitches per start—and be ready for Miami’s bullpen, including Michael Petersen.
reminders: Fernando Tatis Jr. and Jackson Merrill lead off; look for fastballs.
Right-handed hitters: be ready for breaking balls.
Stay selective when Phillips goes offspeed.

briefings.headline: Change speeds, stay down, and own the edges
briefings.message: Nick Pivetta is planned for 4.0 innings with an 80-pitch limit; his matchup split samples are small. Change speeds and finish below the zone to Conine, Hernández, and Lopez. Keep Edwards and Marsee off base with strikes on the edges and no free passes. In a close late lead, Morejon handles the key left-handed pocket, Rodriguez follows, and Miller closes.
reminders: Avoid predictable fastballs to Conine and Lopez.
Mix offspeed to Hernández; his offspeed sample is moderate.
Save Matsui and Canning for necessity; both are limited.
